meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: Claude 会直接向外部服务的真实 API 地址发 HTTP 请求,凭据由 OneCLI 网关在代理处自动注入,Claude 不接触凭据值。若该服务尚未连接,它会给出连接链接,等你连好后重试原请求。
howto.when: 当你要求读邮件、查日历或访问 GitHub 仓库等任何外部服务或 API 交互时接管;它不使用浏览器扩展或 OAuth CLI 工具。

howto.what_en: Claude makes direct HTTP requests to real external API URLs, and the OneCLI gateway injects stored credentials automatically; Claude never sees credential values. If a service isn't connected, it returns a connect link and retries after you connect.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to read emails, check your calendar, or access GitHub repos and any other external service or API; it does not use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools.

say_en.note: Gateway injects credentials, calls Gmail API

say_en.note: Returns a connect link if not connected
Calls Stripe API directly, no key needed
